problem: I am performing research into best practices for low birth weight births. In 2017, which Canadian provinces had a Proportion of low birth weight births (<2500 grams at birth) above 6.0 but an Infant Mortality rate (per 1000 live births) below 4.5? Source all data from Statistics Canada Table: 13-10-0368-01 and Table: 13-10-0404-01. Ensure that all values are for both sexes.
answer: Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Quebec.
